### The scanners in the spotlight

**Article.** The PEPR Sols Vivants programme presents my thesis work on in situ soil imaging, and how digital tools are opening a new window on soil biodiversity: ["Observer la biodiversité des sols à l'ère du numérique"](https://pepr-solsvivants.fr/a-la-une2/observer-la-biodiversite-des-sols-a-l-ere-du-numerique){.accent-link}.

**Webinar.** In this webinar, we present the in situ soil imaging technique and demonstrate its application to monitoring the temporal organization of edaphic activity:

{{< video https://mediatheque.inrae.fr/Val-Loire/media/ajarisvideo/public/DE08BA63CBF8ECF59CA652C2CD9073C0-df5T84LepT/376514.mp4 >}}

**Video.** An accessible introduction to the history of buried scanners and the new research opportunities they have opened up:

{{< video https://www.youtube.com/embed/GgDehGNkYNM >}}
:::
